name: x2md-twitter-post-scraper
title: x2md Twitter Post Scraper
description: Scrape X/Twitter posts, self-threads, and Articles into structured JSON plus clean Markdown, with optional original-resolution image and mp4 downloads. No auth required.

environmentVariables.X2MD_GRAPHQL_QUERY_ID: TweetDetail query id for the graphql provider (optional; X rotates it on every web deploy). Mark as a secret in the Apify Console.
environmentVariables.X2MD_AUTH_TOKEN: auth_token cookie value for authenticated graphql (optional). Mark as a secret in the Apify Console.
environmentVariables.X2MD_CT0: ct0 CSRF cookie value for authenticated graphql (optional). Mark as a secret in the Apify Console.
environmentVariables.X2MD_BEARER_TOKEN: Bearer token override for graphql (optional; defaults to the public web constant). Mark as a secret in the Apify Console.
